title: Hold a petroleum tenure
what: Carry out petroleum exploration or production activities only under a petroleum tenure (such as an authority to prospect or a petroleum lease).

laws.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)

sources.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out a petroleum tenure activity in relation to land unless— (a) the activity is carried out under this Act or the 1923 Act and under the authority of a petroleum tenure or a 1923 Act petroleum tenure;

administration.who: Minister administering the Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)

sources.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 30AC, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The Minister may, under a grant provision, grant a petroleum authority for an area that includes acquired land only if the Minister, after consulting the entity that took the land, is satisfied the grant of the authority is compatible with the purpose for which the land is being or is to be used.
